reasons.amp: the link shows another website through Google's AMP cache
reasons.apk: the link downloads an app file (.apk) instead of using the Play Store
reasons.at: the link hides the real website after an @ sign
reasons.bank: the link is on an official Indian bank website (.bank.in)
reasons.chat: the link opens a WhatsApp or Telegram chat with a stranger
reasons.fin: the link is on the official website of a regulated financial company (.fin.in)
reasons.gov: the link is on an official Indian government website (.gov.in or .nic.in)
reasons.hosting: the page is on a free website builder or hosting service, where anyone can publish
reasons.ip: the link uses a bare internet (IP) address instead of a website name
reasons.listed: the website is on public lists of reported phishing or malware sites
reasons.many_parts: the website name has many parts, a trick to look like a real site
reasons.model_high: the website name looks like the names used by phishing sites
reasons.model_mid: the website name looks unusual for a real company
reasons.popular: the website is one of the 10,000 most visited websites (Chrome UX Report)
reasons.punycode: the website name uses look-alike letters from another alphabet
reasons.redirect: the link sends you on to another website, hidden inside the link
reasons.shared: the link opens a file, form or page that anyone can make on a big service such as Google Forms
reasons.shortener: uses a short link that hides the real website
reasons.translate: the link shows another website through Google Translate
reasons.words: the website address has words like login, verify, KYC or reward
